title: Differentially Private Synthetic Data via Generalized Moment Matching
abstract: arXiv:2610.30196v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study $(\varepsilon,\delta)$-differentially private synthetic data for arbitrary databases of $n$ records in $[-1,1]^d$ under a specified integral probability metric (IPM). We introduce generalized moment matching, which estimates moments privately, fits a probability measure, and samples synthetic records. A general error theorem applies when moment error controls the target IPM. This framework extends Chebyshev moment matching for $1$-Wasserstein distance and smooth queries. We apply the framework to maximum mean discrepancy with Matern and Laplace kernels and a two-layer ReLU neural tangent kernel.We also obtain guarantees for sliced Wasserstein-$1$ and the IPM induced by norm-bounded ReLU networks. With sufficiently many synthetic records,these rates are minimax optimal up to logarithmic factors for fixed dimension.

translated_title: 基于广义矩匹配的差分隐私合成数据
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在指定的积分概率度量（IPM）下，针对[-1,1]^d中包含n条记录的任意数据库的(ε,δ)-差分隐私合成数据生成问题。我们提出了广义矩匹配方法，该方法私有地估计矩、拟合概率测度并采样合成记录。当矩误差能够控制目标IPM时，可应用一个一般性误差定理。该框架扩展了针对1-Wasserstein距离和光滑查询的切比雪夫矩匹配方法。我们将该框架应用于采用Matern核、Laplace核以及两层ReLU神经正切核的最大均值差异（MMD），还获得了切片Wasserstein-1以及由范数受限ReLU网络诱导的IPM的保证。在合成记录数量足够多的情况下，对于固定维度，这些误差率在相差对数因子的意义下是极小极大最优的。
tldr: 提出了广义矩匹配这一通用框架，通过私有估计矩、拟合概率测度并采样合成记录来生成差分隐私合成数据，可应用于Wasserstein距离、最大均值差异等多种积分概率度量，并在固定维度下达到相差对数因子的极小极大最优误差率。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a generalized moment matching framework for generating differentially private synthetic data under various integral probability metrics (including Wasserstein distance, MMD, and IPMs induced by ReLU networks), achieving minimax optimal error rates up to logarithmic factors for fixed dimension.
